title: Phyllis Probable NDE 6111
content: When I was three years old, I had to have surgery to repair my urethra tube. It was something I was born with that need to be repaired. I remember sitting on a high ledge with a girl that was a few years older than I was. I didn't know her, but felt like I did. We both were looking down and I saw doctors and nurses around a bed and asked the girl next to me who was on the bed. She said it was me, and that she had to watch. Being so young, I couldn't grasp how I was sitting up on this ledge and in the bed below at the same time. I wasn't scared, in fact, when I looked behind me I saw a playground with lots of kids playing, the flowers and grass colors were so vivid and pretty. I wanted so badly to play on the playground, but the girl next to me said that I wasn't allowed just yet. She went to tell me that I had to wait a while and then maybe I could go later. We sat there for a while and then she said that I had to go back. I knew what she meant, but I liked being with her and didn't want to leave. I asked if I could play at the playground now, and she 'no' and if she let me she would get in trouble. I remember waking up and seeing my parents and asking them where the girl went who sat with me while the doctors fixed me. They didn't know whom I was talking about. Years later, I asked my mom if she remembers me asking that and she said 'yes' and after much thought she told me she felt that was my guardian angel watching over me. I don't doubt that, but I think I might have passed if only for seconds. I do remember hearing a doctor say get her back, get her back. Didn't know what that meant till I got older.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Sitting "on a high ledge" looking down at doctors and nurses around a bed.

arrival.other_being_detail: An unknown girl a few years older who said she "had to watch" and told her she wasn't allowed to play yet; later mother suggested it may have been a guardian angel.

environment.environment_other_detail: A "playground with lots of kids playing"; "flowers and grass colors were so vivid and pretty."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Surgery at age three to repair urethra tube (congenital issue).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also heard a doctor say: "get her back, get her back."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE from a ledge observing the body and medical staff, with an earthlike playground scene and a guide-like girl, then told to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Presence of a playground with many children while observing surgery from a ledge; companion described as an unknown girl later interpreted as a guardian angel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It was me, and that she had to watch."; "I wasn't allowed just yet."; "I had to go back."; "get her back, get her back."
